title: Disaster Response Damage Assessment
decision_boundary: May this image or video be accepted as authenticated field evidence for the identified incident, location, response programme, and decision time?

cases.condition: recognized actor, valid delegation, and in-scope action/resource/context
recognized actor but action, resource, purpose, or context is outside delegation
authority or delegation is revoked at the evaluated decision time
required authority or revocation evidence is stale or unavailable
material metadata or authority evidence is corrected after the original decision

limitations: The result can authenticate provenance and scoped collection authority; it does not establish the severity of damage, entitlement to aid, causation, or the truth of every contextual claim.
